method: Reviewed all 39 responsibilities, procedures, outputs, hard gates, exact permission identities, mutation scopes, triggers, anti-triggers, holdouts, baselines, and provenance in delivery, observability, and incident/learning batches.
Computed pairwise positive-trigger lexical overlap at a 0.22 Jaccard threshold; manually adjudicated edge-worker versus Web-hosting deployment.
Reviewed all sixteen remote actions as separate one-action scopes and verified every observer, assessor, investigation, classification, readiness, and incident coordinator remains evidence-only.

Reviewed delivery ordering, deployment observation and rollback separation, APM lifecycle, canary baseline immutability, telemetry governance, incident roles, retrospective integrity, and local-only learning persistence.

resolved_findings.finding: Incident-response source material includes acknowledgement, mitigation, communication, recovery, and closure, while the frozen Phase 2 identity is external-read only.
resolved_findings.resolution: The candidate coordinates severity, roles, timeline, evidence, reversible mitigation options, specialist handoffs, recovery criteria, and closure recommendation only; provider acknowledgement, silence, assignment, comment, traffic, scale, restart, deployment, rollback, remediation, and closure are explicitly prohibited.

resolved_findings.finding: Deployment-environment setup could be interpreted as authority to provision provider resources because it accepts provider selection and environment boundaries.
resolved_findings.resolution: The candidate writes only local configuration candidates, secret references, schemas, dry-run instructions, and teardown plans; provider provisioning and deployment are separate remote capabilities.

resolved_findings.finding: A single remote-write identity could collapse push, PR change, comment, merge, deploy, provider configuration, and rollback into interchangeable actions.
resolved_findings.resolution: All sixteen remote candidates have unique mutation_scope values, exact targets, fresh per-action authorization, immutable inputs, durable receipts, and action-specific recovery boundaries; one authorization never cascades.

resolved_findings.finding: Canary monitoring source material could let production observations silently replace baselines or automatically roll back.
resolved_findings.resolution: Baseline management writes immutable versioned local evidence artifacts only; production canary monitoring is read-only and can recommend investigation or rollback but cannot update baselines, promote, repair, change traffic, or rollback.

resolved_findings.finding: Local learning persistence could make unverified inference canonical or imply external synchronization.
resolved_findings.resolution: It accepts one validated approved record, preserves evidence-status and provenance, writes one local destination only, and blocks secrets, unverified inference, unrelated context, external synchronization, and indefinite retention.

boundary_samples.boundary: Preflight is local and remote-read-only readiness evidence; packaging may create approved local commits, version, changelog, and metadata but cannot push.
Push performs one non-force exact refspec; PR change consumes the verified push receipt and creates or updates one PR without merge.
Readiness produces separate fresh merge and deploy verdicts; merge is one PR action at one head SHA; deployment requires a separate later authorization.
Trigger performs one exact deployment invocation; observation is read-only; rollback requires its own met condition, exact recovery target, compatibility, blast radius, and authorization.
Web hosting owns project, build, domains, regions, environment, and hosting traffic; edge deployment owns worker runtime, compatibility version, bindings, routes, and platform limits.
Readiness may inspect and non-mutating dry-run only; deployment applies one reviewed manifest and immutable image to one cluster and namespace.

Enablement configures one known instrumentation path; verification uses a known request and current traces; troubleshooting diagnoses signal-path failures read-only; summary only aggregates supplied evidence.
Agent installation owns pinned host or cluster collector installation and permissions; APM enablement owns application runtime instrumentation and duplicate prevention.
Metrics design defines exact formulas, baselines, guardrails, owners, and linked actions without provider writes; monitoring config creates exact provider alerts from approved definitions.
Log configuration governs service log sources, parsing and routes; AI observability governs model, prompt, retrieval, tool, cost and quality telemetry with stricter content minimization.
Baseline management creates immutable versioned local artifacts; monitoring samples allowlisted production and cannot replace baselines or auto-rollback.
Classification labels governed observed behavior without causality; root-cause analysis consumes a cohort, compares successes, tests hypotheses, and finds the first divergent stage.
Issue investigation is provider-read-only and cannot resolve, mute, comment, assign, regroup, or edit source; remediation consumes confirmed evidence under a separate writer.
Coordination maintains severity, roles, timeline, options and decisions under read-only authority; rollback is a separate one-shot production action and does not close the incident.
Incident coordination is active and mitigation-first; retrospective occurs after a frozen window and cannot rewrite facts or assign blame.
Feedback synthesis calibrates hypotheses and next learning inputs without persistence; local persistence writes one validated approved record and cannot infer or synchronize externally.
Provenance records source and artifact lineage without provider mutation or deployment inference; release observability associates exact immutable identities in one provider.

release_claim: none; all 39 candidates remain evaluating, all evaluation plans remain not-run-phase-9, and all remote or local-system candidate actions remain not-executed-phase-7
